name: Stonebull Lake
summary: Stonebull Lake curves around Bloodhoof Village in central Mulgore, giving the tauren fresh water and fish.

sections.title: Waters of the Plain
sections.body: Stonebull Lake curves around Bloodhoof Village on three sides, shaping the heart of central Mulgore. A wooden bridge crosses its narrowest stretch, carrying the main dirt road between the village and Thunder Bluff on the great mesa to the north. Native fish fill the calm water. Hunters rest on the banks, travelers pause there, and apprentice fishers learn their trade beneath the open sky.

faq.answer: Stonebull Lake lies in central Mulgore, curving around Bloodhoof Village on three sides.

faq.q: What is the bridge across the lake used for?
faq.answer: The bridge crosses the lake's narrowest stretch and carries the main dirt road between Bloodhoof Village and Thunder Bluff to the north.

faq.q: Why is Stonebull Lake important to the tauren?
faq.answer: Stonebull Lake gives Bloodhoof Village fresh water and fish. Its quiet shores also offer young tauren braves in training a place to gather and reflect.

angles.text: As a tauren making a home in Mulgore, you find fresh water and sustenance at Stonebull Lake, near your people's capital.
